detailed_descriptions.en: The third chapter in the FUTURE SAGA series depicts an unprecedented alteration of history! This DLC is packed full of content that will allow you to enjoy DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 even more, including an Extra Mission where characters in new forms are also active, new Parallel Quests, Additional Moves, Costumes, and more. FUTURE SAGA Chapter 3 includes: • 2 New Playable Characters: Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain), Broly (DB Super) • 1 Extra Missions Arc • 3 Parallel Quests • 6 Additional Moves • 5 Costumes/Accessories • 3 Super Souls • 23 Illustrations • 1 Extra Scenario: Cheelai & Broly All Out! Conton City Patrol *This product is also included in bundles. Please be careful not to purchase in duplicate. *Some of the above contents can be obtained by clearing certain conditions in the game.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The third chapter in the FUTURE SAGA series depicts an unprecedented alteration of history!

This DLC is packed full of content that will allow you to enjoy DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 even more, including an Extra Mission where characters in new forms are also active, new Parallel Quests, Additional Moves, Costumes, and more.

FUTURE SAGA Chapter 3 includes:
• 2 New Playable Characters: Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain), Broly (DB Super)
• 1 Extra Missions Arc
• 3 Parallel Quests
• 6 Additional Moves
• 5 Costumes/Accessories
• 3 Super Souls
• 23 Illustrations
• 1 Extra Scenario: Cheelai & Broly All Out! Conton City Patrol

*This product is also included in bundles. Please be careful not to purchase in duplicate.
*Some of the above contents can be obtained by clearing certain conditions in the game.
